title: LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies
abstract: arXiv:2606.15768v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for semantic robot control, but often lack explicit foresight into how robot actions change the scene. World-Action Models (WAMs) address this limitation by conditioning policies on predicted futures, yet existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive video generation with substantial pixel-level redundancy. We present LaWAM, a Latent World Action Model that exposes predictive dynamics to robot policies through compact latent visual subgoals instead of reconstructed future video. At the core of LaWAM is a latent-action-conditioned Latent World Model (LaWM). We obtain LaWM by training a latent action model in the latent space of a pretrained vision foundation model and repurposing its forward decoder to predict future observation features for scene evolution. translated_title: LaWAM：面向高效动力学感知机器人策略的潜在世界动作模型
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）利用大规模视觉-语言预训练来实现语义层面的机器人控制，但通常缺乏对机器人动作如何改变场景的显式预见能力。世界动作模型（WAMs）通过让策略以预测的未来为条件来解决这一局限，然而现有方法通常依赖于计算开销巨大的视频生成，带来大量像素级冗余。我们提出了LaWAM，这是一种潜在世界动作模型，它通过紧凑的潜在视觉子目标而非重建的未来视频，向机器人策略暴露预测性动力学。LaWAM的核心是一个以潜在动作为条件的潜在世界模型。我们通过在预训练视觉基础模型的潜在空间中训练一个潜在动作模型，并重新利用其前向解码器来预测未来观测特征以实现场景演化，从而构建出LaWM。随后，LaWAM以这些预测的潜在视觉特征为条件来生成动作。
tldr: 提出LaWAM，一种通过在预训练视觉基础模型的潜在空间中预测紧凑的潜在视觉子目标（而非重建未来视频），将预测性动力学高效融入机器人策略的潜在世界动作模型。
en_tdlr: LaWAM is a latent world action model that efficiently exposes predictive dynamics to robot policies by predicting compact latent visual subgoals in the latent space of a pretrained vision foundation model, rather than reconstructing future videos.
